Card Q&A.a:
Yes, they trigger simultaneously. However, if you activate BT18-015 [Kimeramon]'s [On Deletion] effect first and then DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] using [Kimeramon] and this card while its [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect has triggered, this card will be removed from the battle area before the [On Play] effect can activate.

Card Q&A.q: When this card would be played, I deleted my BT18-015 [Kimeramon], then I played this card. At such times, does this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect trigger simultaneously with BT18-015 [Kimeramon]'s [On Deletion] effect?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, the DNA digivolution requirements have to be met. In addition, DNA digivolution can't be performed unless the [Millenniummon] has DNA digivolution.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [On Deletion] effect to DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand, do the DNA digivolution requirements have to be met for [Millenniummon]?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, that's correct. The [On Deletion] effect activates after the card is placed in the trash, therefore this card itself in the trash can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [On Deletion] effect allow my [Kimeramon] and the BT18-073 [Machinedramon] itself that activated the effect in the trash to DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand?

Card Q&A.a: Your [Kimeramon] in the battle area and [Machinedramon] in your trash can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand.
Card Q&A.q: What are the areas where [Kimeramon] and [Machinedramon] can DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand using this card's [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: When this card would be played, by deleting 1 of your Digimon with the [Composite] trait, reduce the play cost by 4.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon.
[On Deletion] 1 of your [Kimeramon] and 1 [Machinedramon] in the trash may DNA digivolve into [Millenniummon] in the hand.
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon attack, you may change the attack target to 1 of your Digimon with the [Composite] or [Wicked God] trait.
